measured_links.effective_service_basis: source-native single-visit fruit or seed-positive outcomes separated by visitor class
measured_links.reproductive_dependency_basis: source-labeled Auto breeding treatments provide autonomous reproductive-assurance context for Syzygium wrightii and Thespesia populnea

why_partial_not_complete: The same source-locked study provides visitor-class single-visit reproductive outcomes and source-labeled Auto breeding outcomes for two plant species, but it does not provide a matched island-transition floral-response measurement. The Auto treatments are autonomous-assurance context and are not transported as Izu direct-dependency coefficients.
allowed_claim: Seychelles supplies a fourth independent partial external mechanism bridge showing that direct visitor-class reproductive effectiveness and autonomous reproductive-assurance context can coexist within one source-locked island study system.
blocked_claims: do not call this a complete mechanism bridge
do not infer an island-transition floral response that was not measured
do not convert source-labeled Auto treatments into Izu dependency coefficients
do not treat the three plant species as independent archipelago replicates
do not infer a universal pollinator guild ranking across plants
do not open a formal cross-system mechanism fit from this partial bridge
reopen_rule: Reopen this system as a candidate complete bridge only if lawful source-native material supplies a matched floral-response transition at compatible population or transition units with provenance and uncertainty locked.
